sponsored.t: Relates to the Nesconset Volunteer Firefighter's Benevolent Association
sponsored.sum: Relates to the Nesconset Volunteer Exempt Firefighter's Benevolent Association; provides for the purpose of such association, and its use of foreign fire insurance premium taxes.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the town of Smithtown assessor to accept an application for a real property tax exemption from Tiegerman Community Services, Inc.
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the town of Smithtown assessor to accept an application for a real property tax exemption from Tiegerman Community Services, Inc. for the 2023-2024 assessment rolls.

sponsored.t: Requires each violator of "Buster's Law" to register with the division of criminal justice services
sponsored.sum: Requires each violator of "Buster's Law" to register the violator's name and address with the division of criminal justice services; makes the registration available to the public, law enforcement entities, district attorneys, humane societies, societies for the prevention of cruelty to animals, dog or cat protective associations, animal control officers, breeders of animals, animal rescues and pet stores.

sponsored.t: Permits accidental death benefits and/or special accidental death benefits to be awarded to the beneficiary of Patricia Espinosa
sponsored.sum: Permits accidental death benefits and/or special accidental death benefits to be awarded to the beneficiary of Patricia Espinosa.

sponsored.t: Authorizes owners of certain condominium units to apply to raise rents in excess of certain guidelines as an alternative to making a hardship application
sponsored.sum: Authorizes owners of certain condominium units to apply to raise rents in excess of certain guidelines as an alternative to making a hardship application, where such raise is necessary to exceed annual operating expenses by at least 5%.

sponsored.t: Provides that for members of a public pension or retirement system, accrued benefits shall not be diminished or impaired except as authorized and prescribed by the legislature
sponsored.sum: Provides that for members of a public pension or retirement system, accrued benefits shall not be diminished or impaired except as authorized and prescribed by the legislature.

sponsored.t: Establishes a defined contribution plan
sponsored.sum: Establishes a defined contribution plan for all non-civil service appointees and elected officials of the New York state and local employees' retirement system who are not yet vested in a state retirement system or who are hired after the effective date of this section; authorizes elected officials to join such defined contribution plan; defines terms; provides for contributions to such defined contribution plan; authorizes the promulgation of any necessary rules and regulations.

sponsored.t: Relates to establishing a defined contribution program for which elected officials are deemed mandatory members
sponsored.sum: Relates to establishing a defined contribution program for which elected officials are deemed mandatory members.

sponsored.t: Relates to school district state aid eligibility
sponsored.sum: Provides that no school district shall be eligible to receive the full apportionment of state aid to which it is entitled if evidence is found by the state comptroller when an audit is conducted and such audit finds that a district has inappropriate excess of their unexpended surplus funds and such school district did not reduce the school tax levy in a proportion equal to the excess of four percent of the current year school budget.

sponsored.t: Relates to ensuring access to emergency services via telephone
sponsored.sum: Relates to ensuring access to emergency services via telephone.

sponsored.t: Requires the electronic and print publication of certain school district reports; defines "local officer or employee" to include school officials
sponsored.sum: Requires the electronic and print publication of certain school district reports within 7 days after approval; defines "local officer or employee" to include certain school officials.

sponsored.t: Relates to negotiations between a governing board and a labor organization
sponsored.sum: Relates to negotiations between a governing board and a labor organization.

sponsored.t: Authorizes municipal corporations to grant partial exemption on real property owned by persons totally and permanently disabled
sponsored.sum: Provides that the current real property tax exemption for persons over 65 may also be extended to those persons who are totally and permanently disabled; requires that municipalities shall provide by local law that such exemptions shall be granted to either those 65 years of age or older or to those who are totally and permanently disabled, or to both categories of persons.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the purchase of construction mortgages by the state of New York mortgage agency
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the state of New York mortgage agency to purchase construction mortgages from banks within the state during periods when there is an inadequate supply of credit available for new residential mortgages or available for such loans at carrying charges within the financial means of persons and families of low and moderate income.

sponsored.t: Relates to the investment of public funds in companies doing business in Iran
sponsored.sum: Relates to the investment of public funds in companies doing business in Iran.

sponsored.t: Relates to prohibiting valuable consideration in exchange for human eggs
sponsored.sum: Makes it unlawful to provide valuable consideration for the donation of human eggs for scientific research.

sponsored.t: Relates to qualification for and establishment of a building construction, demolition and repair work insurance credit
sponsored.sum: Authorizes a building construction, demolition and repair work insurance tax credit for certain qualifying insurance premium payments for personal injury liability insurance and property damage liability insurance.

sponsored.t: Establishes a college student expense personal income tax credit
sponsored.sum: Establishes a college student expense personal income tax credit for a taxpayer or such taxpayer's dependents who are enrolled full-time in an undergraduate college, equal to the amount paid for new and used required textbooks and laptop computers not to exceed one thousand dollars.

sponsored.t: Creates the real property regulatory impacts act
sponsored.sum: Creates the real property regulatory impacts act; provides that the owner of any real property may bring an action against the state whenever the application of any state statute, rule or regulation to such property causes a diminution in value of fifty percent or more.

sponsored.t: Mandates a code of ethics to be applied to school district employees in the prohibition of the use of school resources for personal gain
sponsored.sum: Mandates the trustees of common school districts and the board of education of every union free school district to establish a code of ethics to be applied to the prohibition of the use of school resources for personal gain.

sponsored.t: Creates a public umbilical cord blood banking program
sponsored.sum: Creates a public umbilical cord blood banking program within the department of health to promote public awareness of the potential benefits of public cord banking, to promote research into the uses of cord blood, and to facilitate pre-delivery arrangements for public banking of cord blood donations.

sponsored.t: Relates to net revenue distributed by regional off-track betting corporations
sponsored.ls: Racing, Pari-Mutuel Wagering and Breeding Law
sponsored.sum: Directs that any net revenue distributed to participating counties or cities by regional off-track betting corporations shall be used exclusively for real property tax relief.

sponsored.t: Provides for eminent domain reform and creates the "home and property protection act"; appropriation
sponsored.sum: Provides for eminent domain reform; creates the "home and property protection act"; creates a temporary state commission to examine eminent domain laws.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the town of Smithtown to make ordinances regarding longbows and crossbows
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the town of Smithtown, in the county of Suffolk, to make ordinances prohibiting the discharge of longbows and crossbows in areas in which such activity may be hazardous to the general public or nearby residents.

sponsored.t: Expands the provisions of the urban development action area act
sponsored.sum: Expands the provisions of the urban development action area act by amending the definition of municipality and eligible area to include any city instead of specifically applying to a city with one million or more.

sponsored.t: Relates to real property subject to an authorization for a real property tax exemption
sponsored.sum: Relates to real property subject to an authorization for a real property tax exemption in the town of Smithtown, county of Suffolk, with respect to the 2019 and 2020 assessment rolls.

sponsored.t: Enacts Paige's law
sponsored.sum: Enacts Paige's law to provide education and awareness regarding brain arteriovenous malformation and brain aneurysms, as well as information on being a potential carrier of hereditary hemorrhagic telangiectasia, thoracic aortic aneurysms, Marfan syndrome and related disorders and genetic testing for such conditions and disorders.

sponsored.t: Provides that a sponsoring agency must make a presentation at a public hearing before a residential facility for the disabled may be placed in a municipality
sponsored.sum: Provides that a sponsoring agency must make a presentation at a public hearing before a residential facility for the disabled may be placed in a municipality.

sponsored.t: Prohibits employers from retaliating against employees for confronting an individual to prevent a theft or the unlawful taking of goods, wares, or merchandise
sponsored.sum: Prohibits employers from retaliating against employees for confronting an individual to prevent a theft or the unlawful taking of goods, wares, or merchandise; does not prohibit employers from training or re-training employees on policies against confrontation of theft.

sponsored.t: Creates the human cloning prohibition act
sponsored.sum: Creates the human cloning prohibition act which makes it unlawful for any person or entity, public or private, to intentionally or knowingly perform or attempt to perform human cloning; defines terms; makes exceptions; imposes penalties for violations.

sponsored.t: Relates to the applicability of certain provisions with respect to persons injured in the use of scaffolding and other devices for use by employees
sponsored.sum: Provides that where safety equipment or devices have been made available, and an employee has failed to follow safety instruction or safe work practices in accordance with training provided, or failed to utilize provided safety equipment or devices, or engaged in a criminal act or was impaired by the use of drugs or alcohol, and such failure, act or impairment is a proximate cause of an injury to such person, the conduct attributable to such person shall not bar recovery, but the amount of damages otherwise recoverable shall be determined in accordance with contributory negligence provisions.

sponsored.t: Grants real property tax exemption to disabled veterans regardless of whether they served during a "period of war"
sponsored.sum: Grants real property tax exemption to disabled veterans regardless of whether they served during a "period of war".

sponsored.t: Relates to improper employer practices, eligible employees for retirement plans and compensation items in disputed agreements
sponsored.sum: Relates to improper employer practices relating to the continuation of pay, vacation and health care benefits; relates to eligible employees for retirement plans; relates to compensation items in disputed agreements.

sponsored.t: Extends provisions relating to affordable housing development loans to all municipalities of the state of New York
sponsored.sum: Extends provisions relating to affordable housing development loans to all municipalities of the state of New York; assists private sector in development of residential housing.

sponsored.t: Establishes the first-time homebuyer tax credit act
sponsored.sum: Establishes the "first-time homebuyer tax credit act"; provides that a qualified taxpayer shall be allowed a credit against the taxes imposed by this article for taxes levied on the taxpayer's primary residence by or on behalf of any county, city, town, village, or school district in which such property is located.

sponsored.t: Alters the definition of a qualified historic home for the purposes of the historic homeownership rehabilitation credit
sponsored.sum: Alters the definition of a qualified historic home for the purposes of the historic homeownership rehabilitation credit.

sponsored.t: Provides an alternative hardship allowance based on 8 1/2% of assessed value
sponsored.sum: Provides for an alternative hardship allowance for landlords in New York city rent controlled apartments which allows a hardship rent increase where a building's annual net income is less than 8.5 percent of the equalized assessed value.

sponsored.t: Establishes a system of community improvement grants to be administered by and through neighborhood citizens' participation committees
sponsored.sum: Establishes a system of community improvement grants to be administered by and through neighborhood citizens' participation committees; makes definitions; directs commissioner of the New York state division for housing and community renewal to create the community improvement grant program; provides that municipalities receiving such grants establish citizens' participation committees.

sponsored.t: Grants preferences in contracts under the affordable home ownership program to certain police officers, firefighters and teachers
sponsored.sum: Provides preferences in contracts under the affordable home ownership program to police officers, teachers and firefighters who live in the municipality or school district in which they work; defines relevant terms.

sponsored.t: Establishes tenant eligibility for certain housing accommodations
sponsored.sum: Prohibits persons whose income is greater than one hundred twenty-five percent of the area median income from occupying certain housing accommodations.

sponsored.t: Provides for the de-regulation of rent-stabilized housing accommodations
sponsored.sum: Relates to the de-regulation of rent-stabilized housing accommodations; eliminates rent regulation for any regulated housing accommodation that becomes vacant on or after June 16, 2026; makes exceptions.

sponsored.t: Grants tax credit for downpayment made on residential housing
sponsored.sum: Grants credit against personal income tax to purchasers of residential housing in the amount of any downpayment made on such housing; provides that the maximum credit shall not exceed 5 percent of the purchase price of the residential housing; requires taxpayers to meet eligibility requirements imposed by the state of New York mortgage agency.

sponsored.t: Establishes the metropolitan transportation authority control board
sponsored.sum: Establishes the metropolitan transportation authority control board.

sponsored.t: Relates to the Hauppauge Volunteer Exempt Firefighter's Benevolent Association
sponsored.sum: Amends the name of the Hauppauge Volunteer Exempt Firefighter's Benevolent Association, and certain provisions regarding removing gendered terminology; relates to the use of foreign fire insurance premium taxes.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the county of Suffolk to alienate certain lands used as parklands and to dedicate certain other lands as parklands
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the county of Suffolk to alienate certain lands used as parklands and to dedicate certain other lands as parklands.
